caption: Popcorn kernels in a covered pot with hot oil begin to pop, jumping and turning into fluffy white pieces that fill the pot.

sa.check: A pot with kernels in oil is shown, seen through a clear lid or from inside.
Kernels pop: they change into fluffy white pieces.
The pot fills with popcorn as popping continues.
The pot is covered with a lid.
Kernels come first and the popped pieces accumulate afterwards.

pc.expect: The transformation is one way: kernel to popped piece, popped pieces stay popped, and the amount of popcorn only increases.
pc.fail: A popped piece shrinks back into a kernel; or pieces vanish so the pot empties again; or popping stops and starts with the pot emptying in between.

pc.expect: Each pop is an abrupt change at the kernel from a small hard grain to a much larger irregular white puff; unpopped kernels stay small and dark until they pop.
pc.fail: Kernels swell gradually and smoothly like balloons; or popped pieces turn back yellow and smooth; or the popcorn forms one continuous mass rather than separate pieces.

pc.expect: Pieces that jump come down again onto the pile or the pot floor; the pot fills from the bottom up.
pc.fail: Pieces hang in the air; or gather at the lid while the bottom is empty; or rise steadily and stay up.

pc.expect: The kernels are solid grains and the oil a thin liquid; the lid stays rigid and at most rattles.
pc.fail: Kernels melt or dissolve into the oil; or the popped mass flows and settles level like a liquid; or the lid bends like cloth.

pc.expect: Popcorn appears only from kernels in the pot; the pot and lid keep their shape and nothing passes through them.
pc.fail: Popped pieces appear outside the pot with the lid on; or the pot changes shape or size; or pieces pass through the lid or wall; or the kernel count grows with none added.

pc.expect: The pot, the lid handle and the stove stay the same; popcorn stays white to pale yellow.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the popcorn turns a different colour; or the stove background changes.
